caveats: one session of premiums and one price history per pair: the group says these tickers hold the same basket, it does not say the basket is worth its price
the money line is the dearest-vs-cheapest premium INSIDE an accepted group on a 100000 CNY swap; it is the cost of an avoidable choice, not a return
a label with unpriced pairs carries n_priced < n_pairs; those pairs are unknown, never baskets
the 0.30 pp line is the r1803 ruler; --check echoes it, so a refit is a new face and not a silent edit
labels are the board's own residual names after the house prefix is stripped; two different words for one basket (alias families) are NOT merged here

groups.why: premium unobservable for at least two members

sentence: 88 of 1190 labels are written on two or more live tickers; the price history calls 71 of those one basket, 5 a family and 11 none at all. 76 groups of true substitutes survive the clique test and 14 carry a premium spread over 0.50 pp (33763 CNY on a 100000 CNY swap)
